summary: Initialized Kohakuyasha as the repository-backed single source of truth.
Implemented the portable Windows foundation: bootstrap/runtime acquisition, core, SQLite, tray, watchdog, localhost web UI, live observation, autostart, diagnostics, safe mode and automated tests.

Hardened local HTTP/WebSocket security, bootstrap reproducibility, restart/watchdog behavior, runtime cleanup, configuration/database recovery, autostart encoding, tray responsiveness and web UI load behavior.
Added Windows/Linux CI and fixed Windows-only SQLite handle locking plus PowerShell 5.1 UTF-8 BOM compatibility.

validation.windows: 17/17 tests + compile + JS + PowerShell parser passed

summary: Fixed audit findings: diagnostics status leak and concurrent runs, deferred restart/shutdown responses, periodic event trimming, same-port restart, bind race retry, soft internet check, read-only marker crash, version strings; added security/autostart/ws/events tests.
Fixed Kohakuyasha.bat startup failure (encoding/CRLF, trailing backslash argument, embedded Python import path).
User confirmed on physical Windows that Kohakuyasha.bat v0.1.4 starts and works.

Added a global draggable avatar: left click opens chat, right click (or touch long-press) opens the AI personal cabinet; position persists across modules and reloads. Chat history in SQLite (schema v2 with pre-migration backup), /api/chat and /api/character endpoints, assistant extension point.

Redesigned chat (ChatGPT-style, safe Markdown, copy, typing, new chat, maximize), tabbed cabinet (Profile, Avatar visualization, AI settings, System), face-only avatar without circle by default with shape/size/ring/glow options, AI provider settings with local key store, connection test and real Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible calls.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: chat/markdown/XSS-as-text/cabinet tabs/avatar options/provider test via fake server/reload persistence/mobile passed, no console errors

summary: Removed Observation/Tests/Journal pages and the activity panel; Overview gained a clock and a calendar with day notes; Settings gained themes (dark/black/white/auto), accents, custom background, zoom, motion, clock and startup options, data export; avatar gained own-face upload with cropper and gallery, shape/size/opacity/colors, animations, snap, idle dim, greeting and click actions, applied across the site; chat and cabinet panels are movable and resizable with persistence; added Cloud.ru provider; added dialog import and retrieval memory.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: calendar notes, themes, background upload, panel resize/move/persist, face upload+crop+apply everywhere, Cloud.ru test via fake server, memory import/search, chat, mobile; no console errors

summary: Soft kitsune visual style (seigaiha wave pattern, glowing tail-shaped light blobs, drifting sakura petals, serif display headings, gradient-edged cards); unified card/button/radius tokens; contrast pass for dark, black and white themes; cabinet tabs as pills, section cards, sticky action bar, panel open animation and visible resize grips; chat with larger avatar, name/time line, day separators and a working Stop button; overview shows upcoming notes. New settings: wave pattern and petals toggles.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: all three themes across overview/settings/chat/cabinet tabs reviewed by screenshots; stop discards the answer; no console errors

summary: Removed the Anthropic and OpenAI providers: Cloud.ru is the only provider, with DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro model cards plus a custom model id. Overview rebuilt as a compact dashboard with fixed-size clock and calendar cells that no longer drift when the window is resized, content capped to 1160px. Cabinet rebuilt with a left rail (face, AI status, sections), two-column card layouts, AI status banner and a narrow mode. The full-picture avatar now has a transparent background.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: layout measured at 1000-2560px widths (no drift), cabinet tabs, model selection + key + connection test via fake server, narrow cabinet, full avatar; no console errors

summary: Assistant brain: long-term facts about the user (SQLite schema v4) extracted automatically by a short provider request every N user messages, an immediate 'Запомни: ...' command with confirmation, duplicate merging, relevance/importance/pinning-based selection, a rolling summary that folds old messages, and awareness of the current date/time and upcoming calendar notes. All injected into the system prompt with usage guidelines. Cabinet Memory tab rebuilt: editable facts list (edit, star importance, pin, delete, add, search), extract-now, summary card, extended settings.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: remember command, prompt contains facts+time+calendar, manual extract, inline edit, pin, add, filter, summary created after long chat; no console errors

summary: Added the «Обновление» page: checks the GitHub repository for a newer VERSION, shows what's new from CHANGELOG.jsonl, downloads the branch zipball, installs it without touching data/logs/.runtime/identity, keeps the last 3 backups, supports rollback, optional read-only GitHub token for private repos, auto-check with a menu badge and a Windows relaunch. Removed the clock and calendar (UI, API, AI calendar context, settings). Overview now shows assistant and update cards. Fixed UI slowness: backdrop-filter removed everywhere (15 fps -> 60 fps in the measurement), blurred blobs replaced by gradients, drag/resize coalesced per animation frame, polling paused on hidden tabs, static files revalidated by ETag and media cached as immutable.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: auto-check badge, install from a local fake GitHub (zip), data kept, evil data/ entry ignored, rollback, token saved and never returned; frame-time measurement 66 ms -> 16.7 ms median

summary: Overview decluttered: removed the Assistant and Update cards, only the status card remains. The update badge stays on the menu item.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: overview shows only the status card; update dot and page still work; no console errors

summary: Fixed the relaunch after an update: the new launcher now waits for the old instance's single-instance lock (instead of exiting as 'already running'), the relaunch script waits for the old process id and logs to logs/relaunch.log, uvicorn shuts down within 2 seconds with a 15-second hard-exit fallback, launcher startup crashes are written to logs/launcher-crash.log, batch files from a zipball are normalised to CRLF, and the Update page waits for the new server and reloads by itself (or shows what to do after 2 minutes).

validation.real_two_process_lock_race: new instance waited 4.0 s for the old one and acquired the lock

summary: Notifications: schema v5 adds a notifications table; the avatar shows a counter badge and a bubble, the chat shows cards with actions (install update / details / later / restart), the server checks GitHub in the background and raises a Windows tray toast, toggles in Settings → Уведомления. A release is announced once; dismissing it means no repeated nagging about the same version.

validation.browser_smoke_chromium: badge, bubble, chat card, seen/dismiss flow; no console errors
